note: Ground truth for the ontology-v1 end-to-end probe. The point is not tension recall (maple-house already covers that) — it is whether a DECLARED ontology reaches the atoms: does an atom come out typed `coin`/`sceatta`/`ruler`/`mint` rather than as one of the six generic kinds, do declared attributes land, do `attribution` claims carry a grade. Invented scholars and an invented hoard; the coin types are real numismatic categories. NOT shipped into the corpus.
